question: Former Prime Minister P.V. Narasimha Rao was posthumously awarded the ___________ in 2024.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat Ratna**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bharat Ratna** is the highest civilian award of the Republic of India, instituted on **2 January 1954**. It is awarded in recognition of exceptional service/performance of the highest order in any field of human endeavor.
 
• Former Prime Minister **P.V. Narasimha Rao** was posthumously awarded the Bharat Ratna in **2024** for his outstanding contribution to Indian politics and economic reforms.
 
• P.V. Narasimha Rao, often referred to as the "Father of Indian Economic Reforms," is credited with initiating the **1991 economic liberalization** reforms that transformed India's economy.
 
• The Bharat Ratna is conferred without distinction of race, occupation, position, or sex, and recipients receive a **certificate (Sanad)** signed by the President and a medallion in the shape of a peepal leaf.
 
• The award does not carry any monetary grant, but it is regarded as the **highest honor** in India, symbolizing immense prestige and recognition.
